name: copy_sixteen_longs_to_argument
description: Copies sixteen 32-bit words from a fixed block addressed through the A2 register into the buffer whose pointer is passed on the stack, skipping the copy when that pointer is null. It then calls through the A5 jump vector and returns.

name: install_header_copy_hook
description: Scans an index-linked table of entries for the largest value in one field, then, if a library call returns a non-zero result, fills a run of sequentially increasing words and saves a sixteen-word image of the returned block. It points the second slot of the new entry at the copy routine, restores the saved image and returns zero, or minus one when a library call or the scan fails.

name: parse_command_line_into_words
description: Splits a command-line string into words at spaces and tabs, keeping double-quoted spans together and translating the asterisk escapes for newline and escape. The word pointers go into a table, the result is handed to a library call, and cleanup calls free the structure before the stored result code is returned.

name: release_state_and_return_code
description: Stores the supplied result code in a state record, then releases the two resources the record holds through library jump calls when their pointers are non-null. It returns the stored result code.

name: run_loadwb_startup_sequence
description: Opens a library through an indirect call and returns error code twenty when it fails, then allocates a buffer and XOR-processes a global name string twice with the same key, so it ends unchanged. It runs library calls on the buffer and, when the first parameter is two, compares the string named by the second parameter with the global name.

name: compare_strings_ordered
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings byte by byte. It returns zero when they are equal, minus one when the first sorts before the second, and one when it sorts after.

name: build_linked_node_chain
description: Walks an index-linked table, allocating an eight-byte node for each entry and storing a library lookup result of the entry's value in the node. Each new node is chained by storing its shifted address in the previous node's first word, and the head of the chain is returned, or the partial chain when an allocation or lookup fails.

name: call_library_vector_132
description: Calls a library routine through a jump vector at a fixed negative offset from the global library base, then returns.

name: call_library_vector_138
description: Calls a library routine through a jump vector at a fixed negative offset from the global library base, then returns.

name: match_name_and_pad_field
description: Compares the record's name with a global name string character by character. When the record's version character is the digit two and the name matches, it writes a period followed by four spaces over the field after the name; otherwise it leaves the record unchanged.

name: write_dot_padding_field
description: Writes a period followed by four spaces into five consecutive bytes of the record addressed by the A2 register.

name: compare_record_prefix_with_name
description: Compares the record at the A2 pointer with the global name string byte by byte, stopping when the name ends or a byte differs. The A2 pointer is advanced past the matched bytes so the caller can continue from that position.

name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it performs no work.

name: forward_args_with_stack_pointer

name: write_local_text_when_nonempty

name: store_low_byte_via_pointer

name: parse_version_command_line

name: release_state_and_return_code

name: print_library_version_line

name: run_more_pager_loop
description: Allocates a 4924-byte working record and reports failure through the error routine when that fails, then records whether a file argument was given and opens the named input through library lookups. It repeatedly handles display and input until the stop flag is set, and releases the record at the end.

name: send_four_values_to_routine
description: Passes each of four global slots, in order, together with a field of the record to a two-argument routine.

name: scan_for_control_bytes
description: Calls a library routine to fill up to eighty bytes of the record's text field, then checks each byte. It returns one when a control byte appears in those eighty bytes and zero when none does.

name: read_pager_key_command
description: Waits for input on the record's port with a timeout, and when the break signal is set it marks the record as aborted and returns zero. Otherwise it reads a key code and maps it through a dispatch table to a pager action such as scrolling or redrawing, then returns the resulting code.

name: finish_with_vector_call
description: Calls two routines in turn, then jumps through the A3 vector.

name: refresh_pager_display_until_done
description: Resets a record field, reads the first page through a library call and then calls the refresh routine repeatedly while a counter is positive, the window's line position is still below its limit, and the stop flag is clear.

name: process_pager_line_text
description: Runs a text-processing call on the record's text buffer and stores its result in the record. When a flag in the record is clear it also increments the line counter of the window.

name: read_next_pager_line
description: Reads up to 128 bytes of the input into the buffer, terminates the string at the end of the first line or form feed, and returns the number of characters kept. A form feed is rewritten as a visible two-character marker followed by a newline and sets a flag in the record.

name: draw_page_until_quit_key
description: Chooses how many lines a page holds from two record flags, then repeatedly draws lines from the global table and reads a key. The loop ends when the key is q or the break character.

name: read_and_display_until_end
description: Prepares the record's text buffer and an input call, then reads and processes input blocks until the remaining count is below one or the end test succeeds. It releases the input and returns zero at end of input and one when the end test succeeds.

name: print_message_then_run_routine
description: Prints a message through the record's output call, prints a second message when a flag is set, runs a routine on the second argument, finishes the output and returns that routine's result.

name: call_routine_with_conditional_followup
description: Calls a routine with its two arguments, then calls the first argument's routine again only when a flag in the record is clear.

name: seek_and_report_line_count
description: Calls a routine with the record's position and a fixed minus-one argument, then passes the window's line-count field to a second routine.

name: seek_and_report_last_line
description: Calls a routine with the record's position, a zero offset and a mode of one, then passes the window's line count minus one to a second routine.

name: scroll_input_back_by_lines
description: Clears the record's stop flag, then moves the input back by the requested number of lines. It reads backwards in blocks of up to 128 bytes while counting line ends, then repositions to the start of that line.

name: print_text_after_record_setup
description: Calls a routine on the record, then passes the record's output handle, a global text and the first argument to a formatting routine.

name: print_page_prompt_message
description: Sets the window's line position to one when the record's first flag is zero, then writes one of two global text messages through the output call, chosen by that flag.

name: print_line_position_message
description: Writes a global text message through the output call. When a flag is set it passes the window's line count plus one as the argument; otherwise it passes a second global text.

name: print_prompt_for_position
description: Writes a global text through the output call. When a flag is clear it passes three global texts as arguments, otherwise it passes the window's line count.

name: query_size_clamped_nonnegative
description: Calls a routine with a zero offset and mode one, then returns the result of a second call with a mode of minus one, clamped to zero when that result is negative.

name: copy_buffered_bytes_to_caller
description: Copies up to the requested number of buffered bytes into the caller's buffer, refilling the buffer through a read routine first when more bytes are wanted than are buffered. It advances the buffer offsets and returns the number of bytes copied.

name: refill_input_buffer
description: Refills the record's 4096-byte input buffer by moving any unread bytes to the start and reading into the remainder, then updates the counters. It returns zero when unread bytes remain and the stored count is not the full buffer size, and otherwise the number of bytes read.

name: seek_input_position
description: Seeks in the input to an offset relative to the start, the current position or the end, as selected by the mode argument, and returns the previous position or minus one for an invalid mode. Positions inside the buffer are handled without a seek call, while positions outside it trigger a seek library call and a buffer reset.

name: read_line_into_buffer
description: Reads single bytes from the input, storing each into the buffer, until a newline is read or after at most 127 characters. It terminates the buffer with a zero and returns the number of characters stored before the stop.

name: copy_zero_terminated_string
description: Copies a zero-terminated string into the destination buffer, including its terminating zero.

name: uppercase_string_in_place
description: Converts each lowercase letter a to z in a zero-terminated string to uppercase, leaving all other bytes unchanged, up to the terminating zero.

name: parse_signed_decimal_value
description: Reads an optional plus or minus sign and then accumulates decimal digits into an integer, negating the result for a minus sign.

name: conditionally_run_handle_operation
description: Calls a routine on the stored handle with the first argument and a minus-one argument, but only when the first argument is nonzero and the stored handle is set.

name: release_pager_record
description: Tears down the pager state. It releases the record's linked resources, writes any pending text, restores saved fields, releases the handles it holds, then frees the 4924-byte working record and the second argument.

name: send_pager_message_code
description: Passes its argument, placed in a one-entry argument list, together with the number 994 to a routine on the stored library base, and returns that routine's result.

name: query_port_info_into_record
description: Allocates a 36-byte record and returns zero when that fails. Otherwise it calls a library routine with the code twenty-five and the record's pointer, copies two values from linked structures into the caller's record, releases the 36-byte record and returns the call's result.

name: run_with_copied_argument_block
description: Returns zero when the first argument is zero or the lookup fails. Otherwise it allocates a 68-byte node, copies a block of longwords into it, passes the node to a routine with a handle, then releases the node and returns the value the routine stored in it.

name: multiply_longwords_partial_products
description: Builds a 64-bit product of two 32-bit inputs from 16-bit partial products. The low longword of the result is the second input with its two halves swapped.

name: call_adjacent_routine_and_return

name: find_name_in_text

name: initialize_empty_list_header

name: read_console_key_with_mapping

name: emit_key_response_and_return

name: find_matching_list_entry

name: uppercase_character

name: compare_strings_ignoring_case
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings after converting each character to uppercase. It returns one when they are identical and zero otherwise.

name: terminate_string_at_colon
description: Shortens the string in place at its first colon, or at its end when there is no colon, by writing a zero there.

name: send_single_word_message

name: run_with_word_argument_block

name: write_dos_sector_tracks
description: Opens the disk device, then for each track in the requested range fills a buffer with sector images carrying the DOS disk signature and writes it through the device by library calls. Failed writes are retried a bounded number of times, and a failure code is reported when the device cannot be opened or a write does not succeed.

name: run_device_control_sequence
description: Makes three device calls on the disk device at its stored offset: two control calls with fixed argument values and a third that passes along a value obtained from another call.

name: write_local_text_when_nonempty
description: Calls a library routine, then measures a 140-byte stack text buffer by scanning for its terminating zero. It passes the buffer and that length to a write routine only when the length is nonzero.

name: store_low_byte_via_pointer
description: Stores the low byte of data register D0 through the A3 pointer and returns.

name: divide_unsigned_longword
description: Divides an unsigned 32-bit dividend by an unsigned 32-bit divisor and returns the quotient in the low longword and the remainder in the high longword of a 64-bit result. Divisors above the 16-bit range use a bit-by-bit shift-and-subtract loop; smaller divisors use 16-bit divide steps.

name: divide_shift_subtract_loop
description: Runs the sixteen-step shift-and-subtract division loop on the dividend in the D1 register against the divisor, leaving the partial quotient and remainder in registers.

name: multiply_longwords_partial_products
description: Builds a 64-bit product of two 32-bit inputs from 16-bit partial products. The low longword of the result is the second input with its two halves swapped.

name: create_linked_request_record
description: Allocates a 34-byte record when a library lookup succeeds, stores the first parameter, the flag byte and a second looked-up value in it, then calls one of two library routines depending on whether the first parameter is zero. It returns the record, or zero when the lookup or allocation fails.

name: release_request_record
description: Releases the request record. When a linked item is present it is processed first, the record's state fields are set to inactive values, a library routine is called with the stored byte, and the 34-byte record is freed.

name: forward_with_fixed_code_48
description: Passes its argument to a routine together with the number 48.

name: pass_single_argument_through
description: Passes its one argument straight through to a routine and returns.

name: initialise_drive_parameters
description: Saves a field of the working record, sets it to a sentinel while looking up the drive record, then fills several global geometry fields from that record or from fixed defaults, and restores the field. It returns the status of the final call, or zero when no lookup succeeds.

name: read_byte_or_minus_one
description: Reads one byte through a routine into a local buffer. It returns that byte as a signed value when exactly one byte was read, and minus one otherwise.

name: initialize_empty_list_header
description: Initialises an empty list header in place: the first longword points just past itself, the second is zero, and the third points back at the header.

name: allocate_sized_record_with_link
description: Returns zero when the first argument is zero or the allocation of the requested size fails. Otherwise it stores the type value five, the requested size and the first argument in the new record and returns it.

name: reset_sized_record_state
description: Returns zero for a null record. Otherwise it marks the record's state fields inactive and returns the result of a second call that uses the record's stored size value.

name: setup_cli_process_session
description: Looks up the current process record and, when the first argument is zero, allocates a 64-byte block with two fixed marker values and records a looked-up path and flag in it. It then runs library calls on the process's stored entries, replaces a stored timeout below one hundred with one thousand, frees the block when the first argument is zero, and returns the final status code.

name: build_linked_node_chain_shifted
description: Walks an index-linked table, allocating an eight-byte node for each entry and storing a library lookup result of its value in the node, then chains each node by storing its shifted address in the previous node's first word. It returns the shifted address of the head node, or the partial chain when an allocation or lookup fails.
